description:
NOTE:  Once this policy is Enabled, only Disable will remove the registry value. Enabled to Not Configured will have NO EFFECT.

Specifies the number of milliseconds to wait for the volume to be attached by the system. Default is 20,000 (20 seconds)

Registry Entry:  HKLM\SOFTWARE\FSLogix\Profiles\VolumeWaitTimeMS
Type:  DWORD
Values:  Min = 1000, Max = 1000000
